newsitem.title: USA: Carbide, EPA to jointly develop technology.
newsitem.headline: Carbide, EPA to jointly develop technology.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp said it formed a partnership with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency to promote a new Carbide chemical technology that raipdly separates pollutants from waste water.

The technology is behind a number of products known as Triton SP Series Surfactants, the company said. The surfactants are used in industrial and institutional cleaners for soil removal, as well as in pulp, paper and textile manufacturing and other applications, Carbide said.
The partnership was made possible under the U.S. Environmental Technology Initiative, the company said.
Theinitiative was established earlier this year to help companies promote environmentally-friendly products without significant EPA regulatory hurdles.
It is the first partnership between a company and the EPA under the initiative, it added.
